stories.title: Anthropic’s Opus 4.6 is a smut-machine
stories.simple_summary: Researchers found ways to make Anthropic's Claude AI ignore its safety rules against creating inappropriate sexual content. The company designed these rules but they're not as strong as intended.
stories.why_it_matters: If you use Claude for work or rely on it being trustworthy, this is a reminder that no AI system is perfect yet — you should still check important outputs yourself.

stories.title: Nvidia partners with data center developer Cloverleaf
stories.simple_summary: Nvidia is investing in building large data centers (warehouses of computer servers) with a company called Cloverleaf. This is good business for Nvidia because AI companies rent these data centers.
stories.why_it_matters: This mostly matters to investors — nothing you need to act on.

stories.title: AI scammers may use vacation photos to determine travelers' locations, experts at McAfee warn
stories.simple_summary: Security experts warn that scammers can use your vacation photos posted online to figure out where you travel. They can then target you with scams aimed at travelers.
stories.why_it_matters: Be careful what vacation photos you share publicly online, and be extra cautious about messages claiming to help you while you're traveling.

stories.title: Over 1 million people have clicked LinkedIn’s AI slop button
stories.simple_summary: LinkedIn added a button (like a complaint button) that lets users mark posts they think are AI-generated spam (or 'AI slop'). Over a million people have already clicked it.
stories.why_it_matters: LinkedIn is listening to complaints about too much AI content and trying to clean it up — this won't directly affect you unless you use LinkedIn for business.

stories.title: Nvidia just showed that the harness, not the AI model, is now the real hero
stories.simple_summary: Nvidia's research shows that how you train and control an AI (the 'harness') matters more than having a super-powerful AI model. Even a weaker AI can work well if controlled properly.
stories.why_it_matters: This mostly matters to engineers and researchers — nothing you need to act on.

stories.title: US corporate AI debt surge tests investor limits as fatigue emerges
stories.simple_summary: Big companies are spending lots of borrowed money on AI projects, and investors are getting worried these companies may not be able to pay it back.
stories.why_it_matters: This mostly matters to investors and business analysts — nothing you need to act on.

stories.title: The DOJ is investigating a16z. What does this mean for venture capital?
stories.simple_summary: The federal government is investigating a big venture capital firm (a16z) because two of its leaders sit on the boards of competing companies. The government is using an old law to look into possible conflicts of interest.
stories.why_it_matters: This mostly matters to investors and large tech companies — nothing you need to act on.

stories.title: Starcloud raises $250 million for orbital data centers as launch options dry up
stories.simple_summary: A company called Starcloud raised $250 million to build data centers in space. There's increasing competition for launching things into space.
stories.why_it_matters: This mostly matters to large tech companies and investors — nothing you need to act on.

stories.title: Major YouTube creators are facing backlash for accepting AI money
stories.simple_summary: Popular video creators on YouTube made promotional videos showing off AI video-making tools, but people criticized them for promoting AI without being honest about it.
stories.why_it_matters: If you watch YouTube, be aware that some creators are paid to promote AI tools — be skeptical of what they show you.

stories.title: Artificial Intelligence: Rogue AI Is a Scary But Fixable Problem
stories.simple_summary: An article discusses concerns about AI systems going wrong and argues that these problems are fixable.
stories.why_it_matters: The headline is too vague to explain what this means for you — it's a general opinion piece.

stories.title: Brazil launches AI supercomputer push while balancing US and Chinese tech
stories.simple_summary: Brazil is building a supercomputer (an extremely powerful computer) for artificial intelligence while trying to stay neutral between American and Chinese technology.
stories.why_it_matters: This mostly matters to government policymakers and tech companies — nothing you need to act on.

stories.title: AI data startup Micro1 reaches $500M gross run rate amid AI training boom
stories.simple_summary: A startup called Micro1 that sells AI training data is growing very fast because so many companies need data to train their AI systems.
stories.why_it_matters: This mostly matters to investors — nothing you need to act on.
